_note: The welcome email placed in every new Mail App inbox. Edit the wording here; {name} is replaced with the mailbox's display name.
subject: Welcome to Mail App
paragraphs: Your new inbox is ready. It runs on your own Cloudflare account, so your email belongs to you and nobody else can read it.
This message was placed here when your mailbox was created. It wasn't sent over the internet, and you can delete it whenever you like.
label: Important
labelNote: The red Important tag on this email is a label. Labels help you sort your mail: make your own with the + next to Labels in the sidebar, then drag one onto an email or press the tag button when an email is open.

coming: Private file storage on your own Cloudflare account
suggestions: Have an idea or found something that isn't right? Open an issue on GitHub. (On Cloudflare's free plan, Mail App can't send to outside addresses yet, so replying to this email won't work until you upgrade.)
_brandedNote: With a company's branding (Admin > Branding), the welcome email leaves out the app's own links and sign-off, says {brand} in place of Mail App, and uses these lines.
brandedHelp: If you have a question, email {support}.
